title: EIKEN Grade 3 - Last-Minute Interview Practice
disclaimer: Original practice materials for private study. Not official EIKEN examination questions.

sets.passage: Many students visit libraries after school. They read books, do homework, and find information for classes. Some libraries have quiet rooms where students can study with their friends.

questions.prompt: What can students do at libraries?
questions.model: They can read books and do homework.
alternatives: They can find information for classes.
questions.tip: 根据短文找动作，不需要复述整段。

questions.prompt: What is the girl doing?
questions.model: She is reading a book.
questions.tip: 现在进行时：She is + -ing。

questions.prompt: How many books are on the table?
questions.model: There are three books.
questions.tip: 只数桌上右侧书堆，不包含女孩手里正在看的书。

questions.prompt: What do you like to do after school?
questions.model: I like to play soccer with my friends.
questions.tip: 替换成孩子真实的兴趣更好。

questions.prompt: Do you enjoy reading books?
questions.model: Yes, I do. I like adventure stories.
alternatives: No, I don't. I like watching movies.
questions.tip: 先 Yes/No，再补一句即可。

sets.passage: Many families go to parks on weekends. Children can play games, ride bicycles, and enjoy fresh air. Some families have lunch together under the trees and stay there all afternoon.

questions.prompt: What can children do at parks?
questions.model: They can play games and ride bicycles.
questions.tip: 回答一个原文中的活动就够。

questions.prompt: What is the boy doing?
questions.model: He is flying a kite.
alternatives: He is playing with a kite.
questions.tip: fly a kite：放风筝。

questions.prompt: How many dogs are near the bench?
questions.model: There are two dogs.
questions.tip: 数长椅附近的狗。

questions.prompt: What do you usually do on Sundays?
questions.model: I usually play soccer with my friends.
questions.tip: usually + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: Do you like going to parks?
questions.model: Yes, I do. I like playing outside.
alternatives: No, I don't. I prefer staying at home.
questions.tip: 说出自己的真实情况即可。

sets.passage: Cooking with family is a fun way to learn new things. Children can learn how to make simple food and help others. Families often enjoy eating the meals they make together.

questions.prompt: What can children learn from cooking with their families?
questions.model: They can learn how to make simple food.
alternatives: They can learn how to cook.
questions.tip: 原文关键语句：learn how to make simple food。

questions.prompt: What is the boy going to do?
questions.model: He is going to wash the dishes.
alternatives: He is going to wash a plate.
questions.tip: 男孩正拿盘子走向水槽。be going to + 动词。

questions.prompt: Where is the cat?
questions.model: It is under the table.
questions.tip: under：在……下面。

questions.prompt: What food do you like?
questions.model: I like curry rice because it is delicious.
questions.tip: 不要求复杂原因，清楚回答即可。

questions.prompt: Do you help your family at home?
questions.model: Yes, I do. I wash the dishes sometimes.
alternatives: Yes, I do. I clean my room.
No, I don't, but I want to help more.
questions.tip: 自然回答，别背特别长的句子。

sets.passage: Many schools have sports clubs for students. Playing sports is good for their health and helps them make friends. Students practice after school and sometimes play games with other schools.

questions.prompt: Why is playing sports good for students?
questions.model: Because it is good for their health.
questions.tip: Why 开头，建议用 Because 回答。

questions.prompt: What is the girl doing?
questions.model: She is playing tennis.
questions.tip: She is + -ing。

questions.prompt: How many tennis balls are on the ground?
questions.model: There are three tennis balls.
questions.tip: 图中场地上有三个球。

questions.prompt: What sport do you like best?
questions.model: I like basketball best.
questions.tip: best = 最喜欢。

questions.prompt: Do you want to join a sports club?
questions.model: Yes, I do. I want to play basketball.
alternatives: No, I don't. I want to join the music club.
questions.tip: 不必勉强说喜欢运动，可讲真实兴趣。
